definitions.explanation: The expense for raw materials or supplies needed to make something.

examples.japanese: {材料費|ざいりょうひ}は{自己負担|じこふたん}です。
{材料費|ざいりょうひ}が{高|たか}くなったので{値上|ねあ}げした。
examples.english: We raised prices because material costs went up.

examples.japanese: この{料理|りょうり}{教室|きょうしつ}は{参加費|さんかひ}{無料|むりょう}だが、{材料費|ざいりょうひ}として{千円|せんえん}かかる。
examples.english: This cooking class is free to join, but costs 1,000 yen for materials.

notes:
The cost of raw materials or supplies, commonly seen in cooking classes, craft workshops, construction, and manufacturing.

FORMS:
Compound of {材料|ざいりょう} (materials) + {費|ひ} (cost/expense).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {材料費|ざいりょうひ}がかかる: materials cost money
- {材料費|ざいりょうひ}{込|こ}み: materials included (in the price)
- {材料費|ざいりょうひ}{別|べつ}: materials charged separately
- {材料費|ざいりょうひ}を{抑|おさ}える: to keep material costs down

RELATED COST TERMS:
- {人件費|じんけんひ}: labor costs
- {光熱費|こうねつひ}: utility costs
- {交通費|こうつうひ}: transportation costs
- {経費|けいひ}: expenses (general business term)
